semantically_equivalent_models.justification: Graph embedding networks focus on embedding graphs into lower-dimensional spaces, which is a fundamental task typically associated with graph neural networks. Therefore, they are semantically related as both involve learning representations of graph structures.

parent_models.justification: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a broad category of models used for processing data structured as graphs, making them a parent category for specific methods of graph embedding.

closest_parent_model.justification: The most direct parent category for 'graph embedding networks' is 'graph neural network' because graph embedding techniques are a specific application or type of graph neural networks.

child_models.justification: Tensorized graph neural networks are a specific implementation of graph neural networks that use tensor operations prominently, inheriting concepts from graph embedding methods.

closest_child_model.justification: Tensorized graph neural networks utilize tensor methods for embeddings, making them closely aligned with the concept of graph embeddings.

sibling_models.justification: Graph convolutional networks and graph embedding networks both process graph data. They implement different methods but fall under the broader category of graph neural networks.
Graph attention networks, like graph embedding networks, are specialized types of graph neural networks focusing on different graph learning tasks.
Graph isomorphism networks are another variant under the GNN category, similar in hierarchy to graph embedding networks by focusing on specific graph properties.
This model is also a variant under the broad class of graph neural networks, indicating a similar relationship and function as graph embedding networks.
GraphSAGE is a method for efficiently generating node embeddings for previously unseen data, fitting into the broad portfolio of graph embedding tasks.
Also a sibling under the broad class of GNNs, these networks focus on using convolution operations on graphs, related hierarchically but distinct in method from embeddings.

closest_sibling_model.justification: Among the siblings, 'graph convolutional networks' have a very close relationship to 'graph embedding networks' due to their fundamental role in embedding and transforming graph structured data.

unrelated_models.justification: Although it involves embeddings, this model is for dimensionality reduction in high-dimensional spaces, not specifically related to graph data.
Simplicial embeddings focus on simplicial complexes and are primarily concerned with topological properties rather than graph embedding.
Matching networks are primarily used for one-shot learning tasks, which do not inherently operate on graph data structures.
Prototypical networks are designed for few-shot learning tasks, unrelated to graph-based modeling.
This is more related to image-based Convolutional Neural Networks, rather than graph-focused models, thus unrelated.
While related to graphs, this model specializes in positional and structural encodings, which is not specifically focused on embeddings across graph structures.
GraphCodeBERT connects code structure with language models, and while it operates on graphs in part, it is not an embedding-focused network.
